scope: Manually declared inert synthetic session evidence. Expected pairs, signed microsecond deltas and privilege unions are independent specification examples, not runtime-generated results or operational attack/benign ground truth. Profile-invalid input and valid-but-contradictory session evidence are deliberately distinct.

cases.name: equal_timestamp_native_versions
cases.reason: Native-compatible 4624 v0 and 4672 v0 can share a timestamp; equality is an allowed pairing.

cases.name: privilege_before_logon
cases.reason: The explicit symmetric record-time tolerance accepts a preceding privilege record.

cases.name: privilege_after_logon
cases.reason: The matching privilege record follows the same-session anchor by one second.

cases.name: negative_skew_boundary_inclusive
cases.reason: Exactly minus the configured 30-second tolerance is included.

cases.name: positive_skew_boundary_inclusive
cases.reason: Exactly plus the configured 30-second tolerance is included.

cases.name: one_microsecond_before_skew_boundary
cases.reason: A record 30 seconds plus one microsecond before the anchor is outside tolerance.

cases.name: one_microsecond_after_skew_boundary
cases.reason: A record 30 seconds plus one microsecond after the anchor is outside tolerance.

cases.name: zero_skew_allows_equal_time
cases.reason: A zero tolerance still permits equal normalized timestamps.

cases.name: zero_skew_rejects_nonzero_delta
cases.reason: A nonzero microsecond delta is outside a zero tolerance.

cases.name: legitimate_runas_netonly_stays_candidate
cases.reason: Authorized runas /netonly can create exactly this local-token session and privilege assignment; no attack conclusion follows.

cases.name: different_hosts_do_not_join
cases.reason: Identical SID and LUID on another host do not establish the same local session.

cases.name: different_boots_do_not_join
cases.reason: A reused local LUID after a reboot cannot join a prior boot.

cases.name: different_logon_ids_do_not_join
cases.reason: Same host, user and nearby time cannot replace exact LUID equality.

cases.name: same_scope_sid_contradiction
cases.reason: Same session/time key with a different local-token SID is contradictory evidence, not a silent negative.

cases.name: far_sid_contradiction_outside_tolerance
cases.reason: The unrelated SID record is beyond the declared session-time tolerance; the valid in-window evidence remains.

cases.name: other_logon_type_not_newcredentials
cases.reason: Type 3 is not the declared NewCredentials candidate even with a matching privilege record.

cases.name: other_logon_process_not_seclogo
cases.reason: The selected candidate explicitly requires canonical seclogo.

cases.name: logon_without_privilege_evidence
cases.reason: An otherwise qualifying 4624 alone does not satisfy this two-source candidate.

cases.name: privilege_without_logon_evidence
cases.reason: A 4672 alone is insufficient; its absence of a paired 4624 is not a benign label.

cases.name: multiple_privileges_sorted_evidence_and_union
cases.reason: All qualifying 4672 records are linked in time/event-ID order, with aligned signed deltas and an exact privilege union.

cases.name: identical_redelivery_is_deduplicated
cases.reason: Identical source IDs and payloads describe the same two events, not extra sessions or evidence.

cases.name: conflicting_event_id_is_invalid
cases.reason: A single immutable Event ID cannot carry two different privilege payloads.

cases.name: two_candidate_logons_same_session_ambiguous
cases.reason: Two distinct candidate 4624 records for the same host/boot/LUID cannot be resolved by selecting one arbitrarily.

cases.name: background_logon_same_candidate_key_ambiguous
cases.reason: A different 4624 under the candidate key remains ambiguous even if its own logon type is not selected.

cases.name: repeated_background_session_does_not_block_other_candidate
cases.reason: Repeated service-logon background keys are outside the candidate ambiguity guard and cannot suppress a different valid session.

cases.name: ambiguous_logon_outside_anchor_bounds_still_rejected
cases.reason: Output bounds cannot hide another 4624 with the candidate session key elsewhere in the complete finite input.

cases.name: unselected_ambiguous_session_does_not_block_selected_session
cases.reason: Ambiguous keys with no qualifying anchor inside output bounds do not block a separate selected key.

cases.name: anchor_start_inclusive_end_exclusive
cases.reason: The lower 4624 anchor is selected and may link earlier context; an anchor exactly at end is excluded.

cases.name: future_privilege_context_outside_output_bounds
cases.reason: A selected anchor may link later 4672 evidence beyond the output interval.

cases.name: past_privilege_context_outside_output_bounds
cases.reason: A selected anchor may link earlier 4672 evidence outside the output interval.

cases.name: same_luid_on_two_boots_keeps_two_candidates
cases.reason: Trusted boot scopes distinguish two sessions even when their host, LUID, SID and timestamp match.

cases.name: same_luid_on_two_hosts_keeps_two_candidates
cases.reason: Host scope distinguishes two sessions with coincident local LUIDs.

cases.name: account_text_is_context_not_join_identity
cases.reason: The required equal SID establishes local token identity; account spelling and domain context are not compared or Unicode-folded into identity.

cases.name: missing_boot_scope_invalid
cases.reason: No boot identifier is inferred from the host name, record ID or timestamp.

cases.name: zero_luid_invalid
cases.reason: A zero LogonId cannot be used as a session identity.

cases.name: null_sid_invalid
cases.reason: The null SID does not identify a local token account.

cases.name: boolean_logon_type_invalid
cases.reason: A boolean must not be coerced to a numeric native logon type.

cases.name: unsorted_privileges_invalid
cases.reason: The normalized profile requires already sorted unique privilege names.

cases.name: missing_privilege_sid_invalid
cases.reason: A missing 4672 Subject SID cannot be filled from a nearby logon.

cases.name: nested_scope_alias_invalid
cases.reason: Nested/scalar aliases must not produce a different Elasticsearch interpretation of the join key.
